title: She Called For A Tow Truck But The Police Showed Up Instead, Gets OWI
description:
#news #police #arrest 

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:

On February 5, 2022. Officers received a call from a towing company stating that there were two people who got stuck in a snowbank and needed to tow their vehicle in Eau Claire, WI. The tow company stated there were two people and believed they should be checked on as they sounded intoxicated over the phone. The couple was identified as Courtney Moulton & Micheal Moulton. When the officer arrived on the scene, he knocked on the passenger side window and made contact with the passenger Michael Moulton. The officer could immediately smell the odour of intoxicants as he spoke with Michael and the driver Courtney Moulton. Micheal advised that Courtney drove because she only had a couple of drinks and they ended up sliding into the curb and becoming stuck
